task.description: Hypothesis generation and experiment planning where value is judged, not scored: a scientist agent with memory proposes, fresh reviewers and a blinded critic push back, a human sets taste and decides.
closure_criteria: each hypothesis has a written review, a blinded critique and a human decision recorded
every proposed experiment lists its controls and the validation that would falsify it
the human accepted or rejected each hypothesis; nothing is promoted by the agents alone
the same protocol produces comparable decisions over 3 repeated runs

baseline.metric: fraction of hypotheses the human rated worth testing

skills.name: hypothesis-writing
skills.description: How to state a hypothesis with its controls, predictions and falsifying validation

skills.name: literature-grounding
skills.description: How to ground a hypothesis in cited prior work

skills.name: review-rubric
skills.description: Rubric for reviewing a hypothesis fresh: novelty, feasibility, controls

skills.name: blind-critique
skills.description: How to critique an anonymised hypothesis without seeing its author or rationale

agents.instructions: You receive an anonymised hypothesis with its author and rationale removed. List the weakest assumption, the missing control and the cheapest experiment that could falsify it.

tasks.start_condition: research question and human taste notes received
tasks.done_criterion: hypothesis file written with controls, predictions and cited prior work
review scored against the rubric and written to the review file

tasks.start_condition: anonymised hypothesis prepared by the harness
tasks.done_criterion: critique file lists the weakest assumption, the missing control and a falsifying experiment
decision record written with the human's accept/reject and the next experiment, or the hypothesis returned to the scientist with the critique
